entities.name: Croatian National Theatre in Split
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Croatian National Theatre in Split is a theatre located in Split, Croatia. Originally opened in 1893, the theatre is owned and operated by the City of Split and is one of the oldest surviving theatres in Dalmatia.
